line: Thick oil paint that moves: knife-ridged strokes catching raking light, a painting alive on the canvas.
line_cn: 会动的厚涂油画：刮刀堆起的颜料在侧光下起伏，画布上的画活了。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: Paint has relief: every stroke is a ridge with a lit side and a shadow side.
Raking studio light across the canvas is part of the image, not an effect on it.
Forms are built from a few confident knife and brush marks, never blended smooth.
Motion is paint re-laid, stroke by stroke; the surface stays a painting between frames.
Saturated, warm, expressionist colour with a strong dark ground.
not: Not a photo with an oil filter: the strokes have to be larger than the detail they describe.
Not a gallery pan across a finished canvas: the paint moves.
materials: Linen canvas weave visible in thin passages; thick ridges in the lights.
Palette-knife planes for architecture and sky; round-brush commas for foliage and cloth.
A dark warm underpainting that shows at the edges of every stroke.

rules: A dark ground (umber or deep blue) under everything; the lights are the thickest paint.
Complementary pairs carry mood: orange against blue, violet against yellow.
Black is never pure; shadows are coloured.
colour.examplePalette: ground #2b1d14, cadmium orange #e07a2a, cerulean #3a7ca5, lemon #f0d35a, violet shadow #4a3560

type.titleFont: a heavy humanist serif, painted-looking (Playfair Display Black)
type.subtitleFont: sans, warm white, light drop shadow
type.placement: lower third over the darkest passage; never over a thick light stroke
rules: Titles can be painted in with a knife stroke by the assembler's wipe transition.
Strokes re-lay themselves in place; the paint 'boils' slightly between frames.
Camera moves are slow and physical, as if across a real canvas.
Light may sweep across the ridges to reveal relief.

grammar.expresses: entering the paint; feeling before fact
a world read left to right

grammar.note: light sweeps instead of the camera
slight, as if walking past the easel

framing: Big shapes, few of them; the subject fills at least a third of frame height.
Leave a thick-paint passage in every frame to catch the light.

foley: the subject's own world (rain, a tram, a café)
sound.ambience: a studio at night, a window open to the subject's place
sound.silence: the brush stops; one held frame of relief in raking light, music out
sound.voice: intimate, close-miked, a letter being read
sound.musicDefault: cello and upright piano, slow, warm

nativeMoves.name: Light sweep on relief
nativeMoves.what: A raking light crosses the ridges and the picture appears.
nativeMoves.build: static camera, keyframe from a hero frame; beats: 'a warm light sweeps left to right, ridges catch it'.

nativeMoves.name: Repainted memory
nativeMoves.what: The same composition re-laid in a different hour or mood.
nativeMoves.build: jump_cut from the anchor with beats naming the new palette and light.

nativeMoves.name: Stroke becomes thing
nativeMoves.what: One knife stroke turns into a figure or a road.
nativeMoves.build: keyframe from a frame of a lone stroke; beats describe it gaining form.

nativeMoves.name: Knife wipe
nativeMoves.what: A thick stroke scrapes the next scene into view.
nativeMoves.build: assembler wipe transition over a cut; the model never does the wipe.

pitfalls.problem: Strokes smooth out into a blurry photo.
pitfalls.fix: Say 'thick palette-knife strokes larger than the details' in the beat suffix; texture halftone key is not used, rely on animation description.
Name the complementary pair in the palette and in the beat.
Keep faces at cu or wider and describe them as 'a few strokes'.

look.genre: animated impasto oil painting, expressionist, emotional
look.palette: dark warm ground, thick saturated strokes, complementary orange and blue, coloured shadows
look.camera: slow physical moves across a real canvas under raking studio light
look.lighting: raking warm key from one side so every paint ridge has a lit and a shadow side

engine.beatSuffix: Everything is thick impasto oil paint, palette-knife ridges catching a raking light.

structures: one portrait repainted across a life
a street at four hours of the day
a letter read while the painting it describes is made
openings: a dark canvas and the first stroke
a close-up of a ridge of paint, pulled back
the light switched on in the studio
endings: the painting turned to face the wall
the camera walks past the easel and out
